title: 第019章 赌坊下注叶家第020章 千颗星辰可称帝那像我这种万颗的呢
content_zh:
听着那女子的话语，叶炎凝神。
此石很是玄妙？
自灵阁离开，一路之上叶炎心神透过储物袋看着那紫色的石头，顿时间他的眼眸一亮。
“魂力！”
“果然是宝物！”
在这紫色石头内，竟有一丝微弱的魂力波动，若不细细感应，很难察觉。
可以想象，紫色石头内绝对不凡！
有此宝物，明日苍云战那把握的确可以更大几分。
“呵，叶炎！”
就在此刻，一道声音顿时响起。
这声落下，叶炎也是停下了脚步。
“齐山？”
“齐长剑？”
齐家的人，竟是在此。
还真是冤家路窄！
唰……
这里乃是一家赌坊门口，如此一幕，也使得不少的人凝视而来。
“没想到在这里碰到你，叶炎你敢不敢在这赌坊内赌一赌？我来此是为了压我齐家将在明日的苍云战上夺魁，而你敢压叶家吗？”此时齐山冷嗤一声。
齐家，这是在找茬啊，顿时间不少人目光落在了叶炎的身上。
“你齐家不忙着奔丧，还有雅兴来赌坊？”叶炎冷笑一声。

额……
四周不少修炼者愣了。
齐山、齐长剑等人皆是大怒。
只是这等怒气他们也是强行忍了下来。
“明日便是苍云战，叶炎……我会让你亲眼见到你叶家如何的惨败，你父亲叶……”齐山开口。
“明日，苍云战上，我叶家依旧会傲立在这苍云城中。”叶炎直接打断了齐山的话语，道。
“哈哈哈！”齐山以及齐长剑等人大笑，笑声中夹杂着讥讽之色。
叶炎也是轻笑起来，笑吧笑吧，笑着笑着你齐家之人就全死了。
随后叶炎扭头，准备离开。
不过他脚步倒也是停了下来，而后目光看向了这赌坊的匾额。
这是城主府开的赌坊？
应该很讲诚信吧？
这苍云战能够在如今重开，城主府可是出了很大的‘力气’。
既是如此……叶炎嘴角内流露出一抹笑意，而后踏入其中。
content_en:
Listening to the woman's words, Ye Yan concentrated.
Is this stone very mysterious?
After leaving the Ling Pavilion, Ye Yan looked at the purple stone through the storage bag, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
"Soul power!"
"It is indeed a treasure!"
There is a faint fluctuation of soul power in this purple stone, which is difficult to detect if you don't sense it carefully.
As you can imagine, the purple stone is absolutely extraordinary!
With this treasure, Cangyun's chances of fighting tomorrow can indeed be a bit greater.
"Oh, Ye Yan!"
At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
When the sound fell, Ye Yan also stopped.
"Qishan?"
"Qi Changjian?"
People from the Qi family are actually here.
It’s really a narrow road between enemies!
Uh-huh...
This is the entrance to a gambling house. Such a scene also attracted many people to stare at it.
"I didn't expect to meet you here. Ye Yan, do you dare to take a gamble in this gambling house? I am here to beat my Qi family to win the first place in tomorrow's Cangyun battle, but do you dare to beat the Ye family?" At this time, Qi Shan snorted coldly.
The Qi family are looking for trouble. Suddenly, many people's eyes fell on Ye Yan.
"If your Qi family is not busy attending the funeral, why would Yaxing come to the gambling house?" Ye Yan sneered.
Um...
Many cultivators around were stunned.
Qi Shan, Qi Changjian and others were furious.
But they also forced themselves to endure this anger.
"Tomorrow is the battle between Cangyun, Ye Yan... I will let you see with your own eyes the disastrous defeat of your Ye family, your father Ye..." Qi Shan said.
"Tomorrow, when Cangyun fights, our Ye family will still stand proudly in Cangyun City." Ye Yan directly interrupted Qi Shan's words and said.
"Hahaha!" Qi Shan, Qi Changjian and others laughed, with sarcasm mixed in their laughter.
Ye Yan also chuckled, laugh, laugh, laugh, and everyone in your Qi family will die.
Then Ye Yan turned around and prepared to leave.
However, he stopped, and then looked at the plaque of the gambling house.
Is this a gambling shop run by the city lord's mansion?
You should be very honest, right?
The Cangyun War can be restarted now because the City Lord's Mansion has put in a lot of effort.
That being the case... Ye Yan showed a smile at the corner of his mouth, and then stepped into it.
